rule_ar: السؤال يتغير ← تحدد نوعه بثانيتين ← تختار أقرب قطعة ← تغيّر المدخل وبعض التفاصيل (20% فقط) ← تستخدم جسم القطعة المحفوظ ← تغيّر الخاتمة إذا احتجت. لا تجبر القطعة على السؤال؛ لو ما تناسبه اختر قطعة ثانية.
groups_ar: الخطة المختصرة (ملفك الثاني): 4 قصص أساسية تحفظها حرفيًا — الإنجليزي (1)، الوالد (2)، المدينة (3)، تعطل النظام (4) — وفرعان قصيران: نتيجة Duolingo (6 داخل 1) وتحسين الخدمة (5 داخل 4)، والقطعة 7 مو قصة: قالب Past → Present → Future لأسئلة التغيير والمقارنة والمستقبل.

الوحدة اللي تحفظها فعلًا: 4 نصوص + فرعان قصيران + المداخل (بدايات قصيرة تغيّر اتجاه الجواب) + 5 خواتم. أي سؤال: كلمة وحدة تحدد نوعه (learning / person / work / place / change) ← القصة الأقرب ← غيّر المدخل ← الجسم المحفوظ ← الخاتمة حسب المطلوب.

تحذير وحيد: أسئلة الرأي (Why…? / Do you agree? / advantages…) تبدأ برأي (In my opinion / I think … because …) ثم For example بقلب القصة — لا تبدأ بالقصة أبدًا. ولو ما فيه قصة تناسب (أكل، رياضة، إعلام…): قالب Past/Present/Future بكلمات السؤال + مثال من الشغل أو المدينة.

In the past, people ate more home-cooked food and moved more. Today, fast food and delivery apps are everywhere, and many people eat late at night. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. One advantage is that it has helped us save time and organize our day better. However, fast food can cause health problems, and in the hospital where I work we see many of them. In the future, I think more people will return to healthy, home-cooked food.

transforms.q: Here's a bigger question. Some people say food is the best way to understand a culture. Do you agree?
transforms.opener_en: I partly agree with this idea, because food shows how people live, but I think meeting people is the best way to understand a culture.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think food opens the door, but people and traditions show you the real culture.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أوافق جزئيًا)، ثم For example المدينة وقلب القصة عن العشاء مع العائلة، والخاتمة Overall.
transforms.answer_en: I partly agree with this idea, because food shows how people live, but I think meeting people is the best way to understand a culture. For example, in Madinah, where I live, visitors learn a lot when they share a meal with a local family. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, and our food is part of that. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. Overall, I think food opens the door, but people and traditions show you the real culture.

transforms.q: Let's change topics now and talk about technology. Which app on your phone do you use the most?
transforms.opener_en: The app I use the most on my phone is Duolingo, because I use it to practice English every day.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.
transforms.change_ar: المدخل «أكثر تطبيق أستخدمه Duolingo»، والباقي نفس قصة الاختبار كاملة.
transforms.answer_en: The app I use the most on my phone is Duolingo, because I use it to practice English every day. A personal goal I am working on now is getting a good score on the Duolingo English Test. I started preparing because I need the score for my university studies. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes, and the app makes this easy to do anywhere. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.

transforms.q: Thinking about society, how has smartphone use changed the way young people spend their free time?
transforms.opener_en: Smartphone use has changed the way young people spend their free time a lot. In the past, young people spent their free time outside, playing sports and meeting friends face to face.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think young people will learn to use their phones in a smarter way.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة تجاوب السؤال بكلماته، ثم نفس قالب التقنية (قبل / الحين / نفس جملة السبب / الميزة / عيب / مستقبل) بس بدّل الموضوع لجوالات الشباب ووقت فراغهم.
transforms.answer_en: Smartphone use has changed the way young people spend their free time a lot. In the past, young people spent their free time outside, playing sports and meeting friends face to face. Today, many of them spend hours on their phones, watching videos and using social media. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped them save time and organize their study better, and stay in touch with friends easily. However, sometimes they spend too much time online and less time with their families. In the future, I think young people will learn to use their phones in a smarter way.

transforms.q: Finally, do you think technology is making people more connected or more lonely?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, technology makes people more connected, but it can also make them lonely if they use it too much.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم قطعة التواصل (قبل / الحين) وجملة السبب والميزة من قطعة التقنية، وعيب التواصل، والخاتمة Overall.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, technology makes people more connected, but it can also make them lonely if they use it too much. In the past, communication was slower, and people depended more on phone calls and face-to-face meetings. Today, people can send messages or make video calls instantly. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and stay in touch with family at any time. However, people may spend less time talking face to face, which can make them lonely. Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way.

transforms.q: Let's talk about travel. Tell me about a trip you took recently.
transforms.opener_en: I have not taken a long trip recently because of my work at the hospital, but a few weeks ago my family and I took a short day trip around Madinah, where we live.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I hope to take a longer trip with my family to a new city.
transforms.change_ar: ما عندك قصة رحلة، فقل بصراحة ما سافرت بعيد بسبب الشغل ورحلة قصيرة داخل المدينة، وبعدها نفس قطعة المدينة بصيغة الماضي، والخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: I have not taken a long trip recently because of my work at the hospital, but a few weeks ago my family and I took a short day trip around Madinah, where we live. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, so we visited places we had not seen for a while. We went out for dinner, visited a park, and simply relaxed together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. I enjoyed this trip because we spent quality time together. In the future, I hope to take a longer trip with my family to a new city.

transforms.q: Thinking about people in general, why do you think traveling is so popular these days?
transforms.opener_en: I think traveling is so popular these days because it has become much easier and cheaper than in the past.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think traveling will become even more popular.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (صار أسهل وأرخص)، ثم قالب التقنية: قبل / الحين / نفس جملة السبب / ميزة / عيب، والخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: I think traveling is so popular these days because it has become much easier and cheaper than in the past. In the past, planning a trip took a long time, and people depended on travel agencies. Today, people can book flights and hotels on their phones in a few minutes. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped people save time and organize their trips better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the plans for a short time. Also, people share their photos online, so others want to visit the same places. In the future, I think traveling will become even more popular.

transforms.q: Some people say travel is the best education. What's your view on that?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, travel is a great way to learn about people and cultures, but I do not think it is the best education for everyone.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference, even without traveling.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (السفر يعلّم بس مو الأفضل للكل)، ثم «أنا حسّنت إنجليزيتي بدون سفر» وقلب قطعة الإنجليزي، والخاتمة درس.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, travel is a great way to learn about people and cultures, but I do not think it is the best education for everyone. Travel can help people practice a language and see how others live. However, I improved my English without traveling. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. So I think the best education is a mix of travel, study, and daily practice. This experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference, even without traveling.

transforms.q: Let's move on to a different topic: education. What was your favorite subject at school, and why?
transforms.opener_en: My favorite subject at school was English, because I liked learning new words and I wanted to communicate with people from other countries.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I can speak more easily, and I hope to improve even more in the future.
transforms.change_ar: المدخل «مادتي المفضلة الإنجليزي والسبب»، وبعدها نفس قطعة الإنجليزي (الصعوبة بالمدرسة، بديت أتدرب مؤخرًا)، والخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: My favorite subject at school was English, because I liked learning new words and I wanted to communicate with people from other countries. At that time, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes, but I still enjoyed the lessons. Recently, I started improving my English again because I need it for my studies and work. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Now, I can speak more easily, and I hope to improve even more in the future.

transforms.q: In your opinion, what makes a teacher a good teacher?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, a good teacher is patient, hardworking, and always willing to help students. A good teacher also gives advice that you remember for a long time.
transforms.closer_en: So I think a good teacher is someone whose lessons stay with you for the rest of your life.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول عن صفات المعلم، ثم For example أبوك كأول معلم بنفس صفاته ونصيحته. الخاتمة غيّرها لتصير عن المعلم مو عن الصبر.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, a good teacher is patient, hardworking, and always willing to help students. A good teacher also gives advice that you remember for a long time. For example, my father was my first teacher in life. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion. So I think a good teacher is someone whose lessons stay with you for the rest of your life.

transforms.q: Looking at the bigger picture, should university education be free for everyone?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, university education should be free, or at least affordable, because education can change a person's life.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think governments should support students who are serious about their studies.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (لازم تكون مجانية أو على الأقل رخيصة)، ثم For example بقلب قصة Duolingo: السبب الجامعة + التدريب + الـ85. الخاتمة رأي عام مو «higher score».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, university education should be free, or at least affordable, because education can change a person's life. For example, I am preparing for the Duolingo English Test. I started preparing because I need the score for my university studies. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. I am ready to work hard for my education, so money should not be the thing that stops me. Overall, I think governments should support students who are serious about their studies.

transforms.q: I'd like to ask you about sports. Do you do any exercise regularly?
transforms.opener_en: To be honest, I do not do a lot of sport, but I try to walk regularly, especially on weekends.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I hope to exercise more often because I know it is good for my health.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب بصراحة أول (رياضة قليلة بس أمشي)، ثم قلب قصة المدينة والحديقة مع العائلة هي رياضتك. الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: To be honest, I do not do a lot of sport, but I try to walk regularly, especially on weekends. I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and walking in the park is my main exercise. My work can be stressful sometimes, so this walk helps me relax and feel better. In the future, I hope to exercise more often because I know it is good for my health.

transforms.q: In general, do people in your country do enough physical activity?
transforms.opener_en: In general, I do not think people in my country do enough physical activity, and technology is one of the main reasons.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think people need to make exercise a daily habit.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (لا، والسبب التقنية)، ثم قالب القطعة 7: قبل/الحين/السبب/الميزة، وبدّل العيب إلى «الناس يجلسون أكثر». الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: In general, I do not think people in my country do enough physical activity, and technology is one of the main reasons. Ten years ago, many daily tasks took a long time and needed more effort. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work, and people sit for many hours. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, it also means that many people do not walk or move enough during the day. In the future, I think people need to make exercise a daily habit.

transforms.q: Do you think professional athletes are paid too much money?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think many professional athletes are paid too much, especially compared with people who do important work, like doctors and nurses.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think athletes work hard too, but salaries should be fairer for people who help others.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (نعم، وقارنهم بالأطباء والممرضين)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة. الخاتمة رأي عن العدالة، مو الدرس.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think many professional athletes are paid too much, especially compared with people who do important work, like doctors and nurses. For example, at the hospital where I work, one of my goals was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. This kind of work changes people's lives, but nobody pays millions for it. Overall, I think athletes work hard too, but salaries should be fairer for people who help others.

transforms.q: Now let's switch to a new topic: work. What kind of job would you like to have in the future?
transforms.opener_en: In the future, I would like a job where I can lead a team and improve health services, because that is what I enjoy most now.
transforms.closer_en: That is why I am continuing my studies, and I hope to have a bigger role in the future.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة الوظيفة اللي تبغاها (قيادة فريق وتحسين الخدمات الصحية)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة. الخاتمة مستقبل مربوط بدراستك.
transforms.answer_en: In the future, I would like a job where I can lead a team and improve health services, because that is what I enjoy most now. For example, one of my important goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. That experience showed me the kind of work I want to do. That is why I am continuing my studies, and I hope to have a bigger role in the future.

transforms.q: What do you think is more important in a job: a high salary or enjoying the work?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, enjoying the work is more important than a high salary, because when you enjoy your work, you do it better.
transforms.closer_en: Of course, a fair salary is also important, but overall I think that feeling is worth more than money.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الاستمتاع أهم)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة وأضف «ما أحد عطانا فلوس زيادة». الخاتمة رأي متوازن.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, enjoying the work is more important than a high salary, because when you enjoy your work, you do it better. For example, one of my goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Nobody paid us extra for this, but seeing the patients happy was a great feeling. Of course, a fair salary is also important, but overall I think that feeling is worth more than money.

transforms.q: Looking ahead, how do you think jobs will change in the next twenty years?
transforms.opener_en: In the next twenty years, I think technology will become even more important and many routine tasks will become automatic.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think people will need new skills, but jobs that need human care will stay important.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ من المستقبل مثل تحويل «كيف يتغير العمل»، ثم ارجع لقبل والحين والسبب والميزة والعيب — القطعة 7 كاملة. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In the next twenty years, I think technology will become even more important and many routine tasks will become automatic. Ten years ago, we used more paper at work and many tasks took a long time. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, so people will still be needed. Overall, I think people will need new skills, but jobs that need human care will stay important.

transforms.q: Let's talk about shopping. Do you prefer shopping in stores or online?
transforms.opener_en: Personally, I prefer shopping in stores, but I also use online shopping for some things.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think online shopping is useful, but for important things I still prefer the store.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة تفضيلك (المحلات)، ثم جملة عن التغيير بالعمل وقلب القطعة 7 (السبب + الميزة + العيب)، وشبّه التسوق أونلاين بالنظام بالعمل. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: Personally, I prefer shopping in stores, but I also use online shopping for some things. At work, we changed from paper to digital systems. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use, and it has helped us save time and organize our work better. Online shopping does the same for people at home. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the process, and you cannot see or touch the product before you buy it. In a store, I can check the quality, and I enjoy going out with my family. Overall, I think online shopping is useful, but for important things I still prefer the store.

transforms.q: Why do you think online shopping has become so popular in recent years?
transforms.opener_en: I think online shopping has become popular because it saves time, and people today are very busy.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think online shopping will become even more popular, and many things will become automatic.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول يجاوب «ليش» (يوفر وقت)، ثم بدّل قبل/الحين إلى التسوق مثل تحويل التعليم والتواصل، وخلّ السبب والميزة والعيب نفسهم. الخاتمة مستقبل عن التسوق. لا تجيب الورق والنظام.
transforms.answer_en: I think online shopping has become popular because it saves time, and people today are very busy. In the past, people had to go to the shops for everything. Today, people can buy almost anything from their phone. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and now it helps us with shopping too. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the process for a short time, or the product is not what you expected. In the future, I think online shopping will become even more popular, and many things will become automatic.

transforms.q: Some people believe that society has become too focused on buying things. What do you think?
transforms.opener_en: I agree to some extent. In my opinion, many people today buy things they do not need and forget that the best things are simple.
transforms.closer_en: These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together, and they do not cost a lot of money.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أوافق جزئيًا)، ثم For example بقلب قصة المدينة: الوقت مع العائلة أهم من الشراء. الخاتمة خاتمة العائلة وأضف «ما تكلف فلوس».
transforms.answer_en: I agree to some extent. In my opinion, many people today buy things they do not need and forget that the best things are simple. For example, I live in Madinah with my family, and the time we spend together is more important to me than anything I can buy. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together, and they do not cost a lot of money.

transforms.q: Now I'd like to change the subject to the environment. What do you personally do to reduce waste?
transforms.opener_en: Personally, the main thing I do is use less paper, especially at work.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think more tasks will become digital, so we will waste even less paper.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة تجاوب (أقلل الورق بالعمل)، ثم القطعة 7 كاملة تقريبًا وأضف «يعني نفايات ورق أقل». الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: Personally, the main thing I do is use less paper, especially at work. Ten years ago, we used more paper at work and many tasks took a long time. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and it also means much less paper waste. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, so we still keep a few paper copies. In the future, I think more tasks will become digital, so we will waste even less paper.

transforms.q: Do you think it's the responsibility of individuals or governments to protect the environment?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, it is the responsibility of both. Governments need to make good plans and rules, but individuals have to change their daily habits.
transforms.closer_en: I think the environment is similar: good planning from the government and teamwork from everyone can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الاثنين: الحكومة تخطط والناس يغيرون عاداتهم)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة. الخاتمة اربط الدرس بالبيئة: تخطيط + عمل جماعي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, it is the responsibility of both. Governments need to make good plans and rules, but individuals have to change their daily habits. For example, at work my team and I wanted to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. At first, it was difficult, but everyone worked together. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. I think the environment is similar: good planning from the government and teamwork from everyone can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Are you optimistic or pessimistic about the future of our planet?
transforms.opener_en: I am optimistic, mainly because of technology, but only if people use it in a smart way.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think technology can help us protect the planet if we use it well.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (متفائل بسبب التقنية)، ثم قلب القطعة 7 بس: السبب + الميزة + العيب، بدون قبل/الحين. الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: I am optimistic, mainly because of technology, but only if people use it in a smart way. For example, at work we have seen a big change. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and we use much less paper than ten years ago. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, so technology alone is not enough, and people still have to make good decisions. In the future, I think technology can help us protect the planet if we use it well.

transforms.q: I'd like to ask about the people in your life. Who do you spend the most time with?
transforms.opener_en: I spend most of my time with my family, because I live with them in Madinah.
transforms.closer_en: These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة «العائلة»، ثم قصة المدينة نفسها، وأضف جملة عن أبوك من القطعة 2. الخاتمة خاتمة العائلة.
transforms.answer_en: I spend most of my time with my family, because I live with them in Madinah. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. I enjoy spending time with my family, especially on weekends. My father is the person I respect most because he is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together.

transforms.q: Do you think friendships today are different from friendships in your parents' generation?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think friendships today are different, mainly because of technology.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think we need to use technology in a smart way to keep real friendships.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (نعم، بسبب التقنية)، ثم نسخة التواصل من القطعة 7 اللي بالدليل: قبل/الحين/السبب/الميزة، وبدّل العيب ليجاوب عن الصداقة (أوسع لكن أقل عمق). الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think friendships today are different, mainly because of technology. In the past, communication was slower, and people depended more on phone calls and face-to-face meetings. Today, people can send messages or make video calls instantly. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and it also helps us stay in contact with more people. However, people spend less time talking face to face, so friendships today are wider but less deep than before. In the future, I think we need to use technology in a smart way to keep real friendships.

transforms.q: Why do you think some people find it harder to make friends as adults?
transforms.opener_en: I think one reason is that adults are busy with work and family, and another reason is that they are afraid of making mistakes when they meet new people.
transforms.closer_en: So I think adults can still make friends, but it needs regular practice and a little courage.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (مشغولين + خايفين من الأخطاء)، ثم شبّهها بتعلم الإنجليزي وخذ قلب القطعة 1. الخاتمة درس عن الممارسة.
transforms.answer_en: I think one reason is that adults are busy with work and family, and another reason is that they are afraid of making mistakes when they meet new people. It is similar to learning a language. When I started improving my English, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Making friends is the same: if you do not practice, it becomes harder every year. So I think adults can still make friends, but it needs regular practice and a little courage.

transforms.q: Let's talk about something else now: where you live. Tell me about the area where you live.
transforms.opener_en: I live in Madinah with my family, and it is my favorite place.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive.
transforms.change_ar: غيّر أول جملة بس («I live in Madinah…») والباقي نفس القصة، وأضف جملة التغيّر من مدخل «كيف تغيرت مدينتك».
transforms.answer_en: I live in Madinah with my family, and it is my favorite place. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. I enjoy spending time with my family, especially on weekends. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. Over the years, the city has become more modern, and there are more services and interesting places near our home. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive.

transforms.q: What are the biggest challenges for people living in large cities today?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, the biggest challenges in large cities are traffic and long waiting times for services, because there are so many people.
transforms.closer_en: So I think large cities need good planning and teamwork to solve these problems, and this can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الزحمة والانتظار الطويل)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة. الخاتمة الدرس مربوط بالمدن.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, the biggest challenges in large cities are traffic and long waiting times for services, because there are so many people. For example, in the hospital where I work, the main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. At first, it was difficult, but everyone worked together. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. So I think large cities need good planning and teamwork to solve these problems, and this can make a big difference.

transforms.q: In your opinion, what makes a city a good place to live?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, a good city is peaceful, has good services, and has places where families can spend time together.
transforms.closer_en: So for me, a good city is a place where people feel safe and can enjoy simple things with their family.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (هادئة + خدمات + أماكن للعائلة)، ثم For example المدينة بقلب القصة. الخاتمة رأي مو مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, a good city is peaceful, has good services, and has places where families can spend time together. For example, Madinah, where I live with my family, is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. Over the years, it has become more modern, with more services, and this makes daily life easier. So for me, a good city is a place where people feel safe and can enjoy simple things with their family.

transforms.q: Let's begin with music. What kind of music do you listen to?
transforms.opener_en: To be honest, I am not a big music fan. I listen to some calm music when I want to relax, especially after a long day at work.
transforms.closer_en: So for me, calm music is nice, but a quiet evening with my family is better than any song.
transforms.change_ar: سؤال حقائق: أول جملة قول ذوقك بسرعة (موسيقى هادية)، ثم حوّل الكلام لوقت الفراغ بقلب قصة المدينة. القصة هنا مساعدة بس، مو جواب.
transforms.answer_en: To be honest, I am not a big music fan. I listen to some calm music when I want to relax, especially after a long day at work. Most of my free time goes to my family. I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. So for me, calm music is nice, but a quiet evening with my family is better than any song.

transforms.q: How do you think people's taste in music changes as they get older?
transforms.opener_en: I think when people are young they want music that is new and fast, but as they get older they prefer calmer music and songs connected to their memories.
transforms.closer_en: So overall, I think our taste in music follows our life.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول يجاوب مباشرة، ثم تشبيه بقلب المدينة (سكنت فيها سنين ← صارت خاصة + الأنشطة البسيطة). قطعة ضعيفة هنا — لا تطوّل بالقصة.
transforms.answer_en: I think when people are young they want music that is new and fast, but as they get older they prefer calmer music and songs connected to their memories. It is similar to how a place becomes special. I live in Madinah, and I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. Now I enjoy simple things: sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. When I was younger, I wanted new things all the time, but today I prefer things that feel like home. So overall, I think our taste in music follows our life.

transforms.q: Do you believe that art and music should be taught in schools as much as science and math?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, art and music should be taught in schools, maybe with fewer hours than science and math, because learning any skill makes students more confident.
transforms.closer_en: So I think schools should give every student the chance to learn different skills, not only science and math.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول متوازن (نعم بس بساعات أقل)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الإنجليزي: خوف من الأخطاء ← تدريب ← ثقة. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, art and music should be taught in schools, maybe with fewer hours than science and math, because learning any skill makes students more confident. For example, when I started improving my English, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Art and music can give students the same feeling, and that confidence helps them in other subjects too. So I think schools should give every student the chance to learn different skills, not only science and math.

transforms.q: Now let's change direction and talk about health. What do you do to stay healthy?
transforms.opener_en: To stay healthy, I try to keep a simple routine: I walk, I relax with my family, and I try not to let work stress control me.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I hope to exercise more regularly, because I know it is important for my health.
transforms.change_ar: أول جملة تجاوب (روتين بسيط: مشي + عائلة + أقل توتر)، ثم قلب قصة المدينة مع «المشي بالحديقة رياضتي». الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: To stay healthy, I try to keep a simple routine: I walk, I relax with my family, and I try not to let work stress control me. I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and walking in the park is my main exercise. My work can be stressful sometimes, so this time with my family helps me feel better. In the future, I hope to exercise more regularly, because I know it is important for my health.

transforms.q: Why do you think so many people find it hard to keep healthy habits?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, many people find it hard to keep healthy habits because the beginning is always difficult and the results take time.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference, and I think the same is true for healthy habits.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول عن ليش العادات صعبة، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الإنجليزي (التدريب اليومي) وجملة «كثير يوقفون قبل هالمرحلة». لا تدخل جملة الدراسة والشغل، والخاتمة درس + ربط بالعادات.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, many people find it hard to keep healthy habits because the beginning is always difficult and the results take time. For example, when I started improving my English, it was the same. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Many people stop before this stage because they do not see quick results. This experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference, and I think the same is true for healthy habits.

transforms.q: Should governments do more to encourage healthy lifestyles, or is it a personal choice?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, both are important, but in the end a healthy lifestyle is a personal choice.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think governments should support people, but the final decision is personal.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ برأي (الاثنين مهمين بس القرار شخصي)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الخدمة كدليل إن الحكومة تقدر تساعد. احذف «At first it was difficult» والدرس الأصلي، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, both are important, but in the end a healthy lifestyle is a personal choice. Governments can make healthy choices easier by providing good health services. For example, at my hospital, my team worked to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Good services like this help people, but they still need to make the right choices every day. Overall, I think governments should support people, but the final decision is personal.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you helped someone you did not know. What was the situation? What exactly did you do? How did you feel afterwards?
transforms.opener_en: One time I helped people I did not know was at work, when my team and I improved a service for patients at the hospital.
transforms.closer_en: Afterwards, I felt proud and happy, and this experience taught me that helping others can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: غيّر أول جملة إلى «ساعدت ناس ما أعرفهم» والمرضى هم الغرباء، والجسم نفس القصة. آخر جملة لازم تجاوب «كيف حسّيت» قبل الدرس.
transforms.answer_en: One time I helped people I did not know was at work, when my team and I improved a service for patients at the hospital. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time, and most of them were people I had never met before. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. At first, it was difficult, but everyone worked together. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Afterwards, I felt proud and happy, and this experience taught me that helping others can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Describe a time when your travel plans suddenly changed. Where were you going? What went wrong? How did you deal with the situation?
transforms.opener_en: One time my travel plans suddenly changed was when I was going to Jeddah with my family for a short trip, but on that day our computer system at work suddenly went down.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me the importance of being prepared, even when plans suddenly change.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة مجبورة: قل إنك كنت رايح جدة مع العائلة وأجّلت الرحلة عشان النظام تعطل، وبعدها نفس قصة النظام حرفيًا. لا تغيّر أي شي بالجسم.
transforms.answer_en: One time my travel plans suddenly changed was when I was going to Jeddah with my family for a short trip, but on that day our computer system at work suddenly went down. It was a serious problem because we use the system for most of our work, so I decided to delay the trip and stay with my team. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. This experience taught me the importance of being prepared, even when plans suddenly change.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you changed a habit in order to be healthier. What was the habit? What did you do to change it? Was the change difficult?
transforms.opener_en: One habit I changed in order to be healthier was avoiding speaking English, because this habit made me feel stressed and less confident.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I can speak more easily, and I want to continue this healthy habit in the future.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة مجبورة: العادة القديمة = تتجنب الكلام والتوتر، والعادة الجديدة = تدريب يومي، والصحة هنا نفسية (توتر أقل). الجسم نفس قصة الإنجليزي، وزوّد «The change was not easy» عشان جزء «كان صعب؟».
transforms.answer_en: One habit I changed in order to be healthier was avoiding speaking English, because this habit made me feel stressed and less confident. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. To change this habit, I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. The change was not easy. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident and less stressed. Now, I can speak more easily, and I want to continue this healthy habit in the future.

transforms.q: Some companies pay for their employees to take courses and learn new skills. Do you think companies should do this? What are the benefits? Are there any risks for the company?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, companies should do this because new skills help employees do their work better.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think the benefits are bigger than the risks.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الشركات لازم تسوي كذا)، بعدين For example بقصة الإنجليزي كدليل، وجملة «هذا يفيدني بالشغل والشركة». أضف جملة وحدة عن الخطر (الموظف يطلع بعد الدورة) قبل الخاتمة.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, companies should do this because new skills help employees do their work better. For example, I started improving my English because I need it for my work. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Now, I can speak more easily, and this helps me at work, so the company benefits too. One risk is that an employee may leave the company after the course, so the company loses its money. Overall, I think the benefits are bigger than the risks.

transforms.q: Some cities have made public transport free in the city center. Do you think this is a good idea? What would the advantages be? What problems could it cause?
transforms.opener_en: I think free public transport in the city center is a good idea because it helps more people move around easily.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and good transport is part of that.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، بعدين For example بالمدينة المنورة وجملة العائلة، وزوّد جملة ميزة وجملة مشكلة. احذف «I have lived here for many years».
transforms.answer_en: I think free public transport in the city center is a good idea because it helps more people move around easily. For example, I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and free transport would make these trips easier. One advantage is less traffic and cleaner air in the center. However, it could cause problems, because the city must pay for it and buses may become crowded. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and good transport is part of that.

transforms.q: Many supermarkets now charge customers for plastic bags. Do you think this is an effective way to protect the environment? What else could supermarkets do?
transforms.opener_en: I think charging for plastic bags is an effective way to protect the environment because small changes in daily habits can make a big difference.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think small steps like this are useful when everyone takes part.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، بعدين For example بقصة الورق→الديجيتال (مختصرة) وزوّد «we use much less paper now». احذف جملة العيوب والمستقبل، وجملة «وش كمان يسوون» قبل الخاتمة.
transforms.answer_en: I think charging for plastic bags is an effective way to protect the environment because small changes in daily habits can make a big difference. For example, ten years ago, we used a lot of paper at work, but today we use digital systems. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and we use much less paper now. In the same way, a small charge can help people change their habits. Supermarkets could also sell cheap reusable bags and reduce plastic packaging. Overall, I think small steps like this are useful when everyone takes part.

transforms.q: Some universities require every student to complete a work placement before graduating. Do you think this should be required for all students? Why or why not? What could students gain from it?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, a work placement should be required for all students because real work teaches things that students cannot learn from books.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared, and I think every student should learn this before graduating.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (لازم يكون إجباري)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة النظام، وجملة وحدة عن وش يكسب الطالب. احذف «It was a serious problem…».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, a work placement should be required for all students because real work teaches things that students cannot learn from books. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. Students can gain the same things from a placement: teamwork, dealing with pressure, and confidence. This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared, and I think every student should learn this before graduating.

transforms.q: Some people save for years to buy a home, while others prefer to rent and use their money for other things. Which do you think is better? What are the reasons for your choice? What is one disadvantage?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, buying a home is better because it gives a family stability for many years.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a home is worth it in the long term.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الشراء أحسن = استقرار)، بعدين For example بجملة «عشت هنا سنين» كدليل، وزوّد جملة عيب. لا تبدأ بـ My favorite place.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, buying a home is better because it gives a family stability for many years. For example, I live in Madinah with my family, and I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and a stable home makes these moments feel more secure. One disadvantage is that saving for years is difficult, and people may not have money for other things. Overall, I think a home is worth it in the long term.

transforms.q: Many clinics now offer video appointments instead of face-to-face visits. Do you think this is a good change for patients? What are the benefits? When is a face-to-face visit still necessary?
transforms.opener_en: I think video appointments are a good change for many patients because they save time.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think the best system uses both.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، بعدين For example بقلب قصة المستشفى (الانتظار) كدليل إن توفير الوقت مهم، وجملة وحدة متى الزيارة الحضورية ضرورية. لا تبدأ بـ One of my goals.
transforms.answer_en: I think video appointments are a good change for many patients because they save time. For example, I work in a hospital, and my team once worked to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Video appointments can help in the same way, because patients do not need to travel or wait. However, a face-to-face visit is still necessary when the doctor needs to examine the patient. Overall, I think the best system uses both.

transforms.q: Some people think schools should teach practical subjects such as cooking and managing money. Do you agree? Which practical subject would be the most useful? Would anything be lost?
transforms.opener_en: I agree that schools should teach practical subjects, because they help young people take responsibility for their own lives.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think practical subjects can prepare students for real life.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول + جملة «أي مادة أنفع»، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الوالد (المسؤولية). زوّد جملة عن وش ممكن ينضيع، واحذف الخاتمة الأصلية.
transforms.answer_en: I agree that schools should teach practical subjects, because they help young people take responsibility for their own lives. I think managing money would be the most useful subject. For example, when I was younger, my father taught me to take responsibility and work hard. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. However, not every student has someone like this at home, so schools can help. Something could be lost, because there would be less time for traditional subjects, but a good balance is possible. Overall, I think practical subjects can prepare students for real life.

transforms.q: Some companies have moved to a four-day working week with the same pay. Do you think this is a good idea? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I think a four-day working week can be a good idea, because rested employees can work better and get more done.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think it is a good idea when it is organized well.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الراحة تزيد الإنتاجية)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الخدمة: غيّرنا طريقة الشغل مو ساعات أكثر. زوّد جملة «بس المستشفى لازم يستمر» وخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I think a four-day working week can be a good idea, because rested employees can work better and get more done. For example, one of my important goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Better organization gave better results, not more hours. However, in a hospital, services must continue every day, so the company needs a good plan. Overall, I think it is a good idea when it is organized well.

transforms.q: You talked about rest and productivity. What about customers and services that people need on the fifth day? How could a company deal with that?
transforms.opener_en: I think a company should organize its teams in shifts so that the service continues every day, and it needs a good backup plan.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that organizations need a good plan and good teamwork to keep their services running.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة (شفتات + خطة بديلة)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة النظام كدليل على الـ backup plan. احذف «It was a serious problem».
transforms.answer_en: I think a company should organize its teams in shifts so that the service continues every day, and it needs a good backup plan. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. In the same way, if part of the team is off on the fifth day, another team can cover the customers. This experience taught me that organizations need a good plan and good teamwork to keep their services running.

transforms.q: Some schools have stopped organizing competitive sports days because weaker students feel embarrassed. Do you agree with this decision? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I do not agree with this decision, because competition teaches students how to deal with a result that is lower than they wanted.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think losing sometimes is part of learning.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (ما أوافق)، بعدين For example بدرجة الـ85 ومراجعة الأخطاء. زوّد جملة «المدارس تخلي اليوم ألطف بس ما توقفه»، واحذف سبب الجامعة.
transforms.answer_en: I do not agree with this decision, because competition teaches students how to deal with a result that is lower than they wanted. For example, my first Duolingo English Test score was 85, which was lower than my goal. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes. I learned a lot from the experience, and now I am working hard to get a higher score. If I had never tried, I would not have learned this lesson. Schools can make sports days friendlier, but they should not stop them. Overall, I think losing sometimes is part of learning.

transforms.q: You mentioned motivation and learning how to lose. What about students who have a health problem or a disability? How should schools include them on a sports day?
transforms.opener_en: I think schools should change the way the day is organized so that every student can take part in some way.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference for everyone.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة مجبورة: جاوب مباشرة (غيّروا طريقة التنظيم)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الخدمة كمثال على «ندرس المشكلة ونغيّر الطريقة». احذف «At first it was difficult» ولا تطول.
transforms.answer_en: I think schools should change the way the day is organized so that every student can take part in some way. For example, at my hospital, we once faced a planning problem. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, a school can study the needs of these students and give them different roles, such as team activities. This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference for everyone.

transforms.q: Some people think that news websites should clearly label every article that was written by artificial intelligence. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I agree that news websites should label these articles, because people have the right to know who wrote what they read.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, and a clear label is part of that.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أوافق = حق القارئ يعرف)، بعدين جملة المميزات والعيوب من قطعة التقنية، واربط «المشاكل التقنية» بأخطاء الذكاء الاصطناعي. احذف الماضي والحاضر.
transforms.answer_en: I agree that news websites should label these articles, because people have the right to know who wrote what they read. Technology has many advantages and disadvantages. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, and in the same way, AI can make mistakes in an article. At work, we use digital systems, but we always check important information ourselves. A clear label helps readers trust the website and check the facts. Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, and a clear label is part of that.

transforms.q: You focused on trust and mistakes. Do you think a label would change how many people actually read those articles, and would that matter for news companies?
transforms.opener_en: I think some people might read those articles less at first, but in the long term, honesty is better for a news company.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think it matters for the companies, but honesty brings more readers in the end.
