For example, at my hospital, we once worked to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot, and patients were happier with our service. In the same way, honest news companies will keep their readers' trust. Overall, I think it matters for the companies, but honesty brings more readers in the end.

transforms.q: Some restaurants have started charging customers who leave large amounts of food on their plates. Do you agree with this practice? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I agree with this practice, because it teaches people to take responsibility for what they order.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think this practice is fair when it is explained clearly.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة مجبورة: رأي أول (أوافق = مسؤولية)، بعدين For example بجملة الوالد «علّمني المسؤولية» وصفاته. زوّد جملة عن الأطباق الأصغر، وخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I agree with this practice, because it teaches people to take responsibility for what they order. For example, when I was younger, my father taught me to take responsibility and work hard. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. I still remember his advice, and I try to be responsible in small things too, like not wasting food. A small charge reminds people not to waste food, which is a problem in many restaurants. However, restaurants should also offer smaller portions so that customers have a choice. Overall, I think this practice is fair when it is explained clearly.

transforms.q: You talked about the customers. How could a restaurant reduce waste inside the kitchen itself, before the food even reaches the table?
transforms.opener_en: I think a restaurant should study the problem inside the kitchen and change the way it works, for example by planning the amounts better.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning and teamwork can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة (يدرسون المشكلة ويغيّرون الطريقة)، بعدين قلب قصة الخدمة كمثال على التخطيط بجملة ربط «عندنا تجربة شبهها». احذف جملة الهدف والانتظار الطويل، والخاتمة درس.
transforms.answer_en: I think a restaurant should study the problem inside the kitchen and change the way it works, for example by planning the amounts better. At my hospital, we had a similar experience when we wanted to reduce the waiting time for patients. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. At first, it was difficult, but everyone worked together. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, a kitchen team can check what is wasted every day and order less of it. This experience taught me that good planning and teamwork can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Some people believe that teenagers should have a part-time job while they are still at school. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I agree that teenagers should have a part-time job, because it teaches them responsibility and the value of hard work.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think patience and hard work can help people succeed, and a part-time job teaches this early.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أوافق = مسؤولية وشغل جاد)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الوالد. زوّد جملة تحديد الساعات، والخاتمة تبني على «patience and hard work».
transforms.answer_en: I agree that teenagers should have a part-time job, because it teaches them responsibility and the value of hard work. For example, when I was younger, my father taught me to take responsibility and work hard. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. A part-time job teaches the same lesson in a practical way, because teenagers learn to manage their time and money. However, the hours should be limited so that school always comes first. Overall, I think patience and hard work can help people succeed, and a part-time job teaches this early.

transforms.q: You suggested a limit on the hours. Who do you think should control that limit: the family, the school, or the government?
transforms.opener_en: I think the family should control that limit, because parents know their children best.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think the family is the best place to control this.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة (العائلة)، بعدين For example بقلب قصة الوالد وجملة «ما نتفق دايم بس أحترم رأيه». زوّد جملة عن دور الحكومة والمدرسة.
transforms.answer_en: I think the family should control that limit, because parents know their children best. For example, my father is the person who taught me to take responsibility and work hard when I was younger. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and his guidance was more useful than any general rule. The government can set a maximum number of hours, and the school can inform parents if grades go down, but the daily decision should be made at home. Overall, I think the family is the best place to control this.

transforms.q: Some cities have banned private cars from the historic center. Do you think other cities should do the same? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: I think other cities should do the same in their historic centers, because it makes the area more peaceful and safer for visitors.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and a car-free center could be part of that.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، بعدين For example بالمدينة المنورة (مدينة هادئة + جملة العائلة) واربطها بقلة السيارات. زوّد جملة أصحاب المحلات، وخاتمة المستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: I think other cities should do the same in their historic centers, because it makes the area more peaceful and safer for visitors. For example, I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and these places are much nicer when there is less traffic. However, shop owners may worry about fewer customers, so the city needs good public transport and parking outside the center. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and a car-free center could be part of that.

transforms.q: You mentioned the shop owners. What about people who cannot walk far, such as elderly residents or parents with young children? How should a car-free center work for them?
transforms.opener_en: I think the city should plan special services for them, such as small electric buses, drop-off points, and permits for residents who live in the center.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference for everyone.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة بحلول (باصات صغيرة، نقاط نزول، تصاريح)، بعدين قلب قصة الخدمة كمثال على «ندرس المشكلة قبل نقرر». خاتمة درس.
transforms.answer_en: I think the city should plan special services for them, such as small electric buses, drop-off points, and permits for residents who live in the center. At my hospital, we faced a similar planning problem. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, a city should study the needs of elderly people and families with children before it bans cars. This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference for everyone.

transforms.q: Let's start by talking about money. How do you usually decide what to spend your money on each month?
transforms.opener_en: I usually decide by thinking about my family's needs first, and then I keep a small amount each month for simple activities together.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think spending on family time is money well spent.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ بجواب مباشر عن الفلوس (العائلة أول)، ثم قلب قصة المدينة: العشاء والحديقة والاسترخاء. احذف جملة المستقبل واختم برأي.
transforms.answer_en: I usually decide by thinking about my family's needs first, and then I keep a small amount each month for simple activities together. I live in Madinah with my family, and it is a peaceful city with many interesting places. For example, sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, which does not cost a lot. I have lived here for many years, which makes these small activities very special to me. I also try to save a little for my studies. Overall, I think spending on family time is money well spent.

transforms.q: Now let's think more generally. Do you think young people in your country are good at saving money?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, many young people in my country are not very good at saving money, but I think this is slowly changing.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think young people will learn to use these tools in a smarter way and save more.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول جملة، ثم قالب 7 بموضوع الفلوس: قبل كاش، الحين تطبيقات، جملة السبب نفسها، الميزة (organize our money)، However (in a short time)، ومستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, many young people in my country are not very good at saving money, but I think this is slowly changing. In the past, people used cash, and they could see how much they spent. Today, young people use apps and online shopping for most of their spending. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our money better. However, sometimes it is too easy to spend money online, and savings can disappear in a short time. In the future, I think young people will learn to use these tools in a smarter way and save more.

transforms.q: Here's a harder question. Some people say that talking openly about salaries would make workplaces fairer. Do you agree?
transforms.opener_en: I partly agree. In my opinion, talking openly about salaries has both advantages and disadvantages.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think it is useful only when the company explains its salary system clearly.
transforms.change_ar: ما فيه قصة تناسب، خذ هيكل 7 بس: ميزة بجملة «it has helped us save time and organize our work better» عن نظام الرواتب الواضح، ثم However «for a short time»، ثم Overall. لا تدخل التقنية ولا النظام.
transforms.answer_en: I partly agree. In my opinion, talking openly about salaries has both advantages and disadvantages. One advantage is that people can see if they are paid fairly for the same work. In my workplace, the salary system is clear, and it has helped us save time and organize our work better, because there are fewer arguments about pay. However, sometimes talking about salaries can cause problems between colleagues for a short time, because people compare themselves and feel unhappy, and we depend a lot on teamwork. Overall, I think it is useful only when the company explains its salary system clearly.

transforms.q: Let's change topics now and talk about advertising. Where do you usually see or hear advertisements?
transforms.opener_en: I usually see advertisements on my phone, especially on social media and in apps, and I hear some on the radio when I drive.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think online ads are the ones I notice most.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة (الجوال + الراديو عشان see or hear)، ثم جملتين قبل/الحين من قالب 7 وجملة السبب نفسها وHowever مقصورة. لا تطوّل، السؤال بسيط.
transforms.answer_en: I usually see advertisements on my phone, especially on social media and in apps, and I hear some on the radio when I drive. I also see some ads on the streets of Madinah, where I live with my family. In the past, most advertisements were on TV and in newspapers. Today, most of them are online, and they follow what you search for. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. However, sometimes too many ads can stop what I am doing for a short time. Overall, I think online ads are the ones I notice most.

transforms.q: Thinking about society, how has advertising changed compared with twenty years ago?
transforms.opener_en: Twenty years ago, most advertisements were on TV, on the radio, and in newspapers.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think advertising will become even more personal, and many ads will be made automatically.
transforms.change_ar: نفس قالب 7 حرفيًا: قبل ← الحين ← السبب ← ميزة ← However ← مستقبل. بدّل «paper/computers» بـ TV/online بس.
transforms.answer_en: Twenty years ago, most advertisements were on TV, on the radio, and in newspapers. Today, most advertising is online, on phones and social media, and it follows what people search for. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and find products and prices quickly. However, sometimes too many ads can stop what we are doing for a short time, and some of them are not honest. In the future, I think advertising will become even more personal, and many ads will be made automatically.

transforms.q: Finally, do you think there should be stricter rules on advertising aimed at children?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think there should be stricter rules, because children cannot always understand that an advertisement is trying to sell them something.
transforms.closer_en: That is why clear rules can protect children from ads that are not honest.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (نعم، لازم قوانين)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الوالد: علّمني المسؤولية. اختم إن مو كل طفل عنده توجيه، فالقوانين تحمي.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think there should be stricter rules, because children cannot always understand that an advertisement is trying to sell them something. In my opinion, families have a role too. For example, when I was younger, my father taught me to take responsibility and work hard, so I learned that money is not easy to get. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others, and I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. However, not every child gets this kind of guidance at home. That is why clear rules can protect children from ads that are not honest.

transforms.q: Let's begin with public transport. How often do you use buses or trains in your city?
transforms.opener_en: To be honest, I do not use buses or trains very often, because in Madinah most people, including my family, usually go by car.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern, and I hope public transport will become better too.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب بصراحة (نادرًا)، ثم قلب قصة المدينة كسبب: كل شي قريب بالسيارة. الخاتمة مستقبل المدينة + المواصلات.
transforms.answer_en: To be honest, I do not use buses or trains very often, because in Madinah most people, including my family, usually go by car. Madinah is a peaceful city with many interesting places, and most of them are easy to reach by car. On weekends, sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, so I know the roads very well. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern, and I hope public transport will become better too.

transforms.q: More generally, what stops people in your country from using public transport?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, the main thing that stops people is that they are used to their own cars, and public transport is not available everywhere.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think more people will use public transport when it becomes faster and easier to use.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول جملة، ثم قالب 7 بموضوع المواصلات: قبل سيارات، الحين باصات ومترو، «This change happened because» بسبب جديد، ميزة «save time and organize»، However (بعيد + حر)، مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, the main thing that stops people is that they are used to their own cars, and public transport is not available everywhere. In the past, most cities depended on cars and had few buses. Today, some cities have new buses and a metro, but many people still drive. This change happened because the cities became bigger and traffic became a serious problem. It has helped us save time and organize our day better. However, sometimes the service is not close to their homes, and summer is very hot. In the future, I think more people will use public transport when it becomes faster and easier to use.

transforms.q: Here's a bigger question. Do you think governments should make driving more expensive in order to reduce traffic?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, making driving more expensive is not the best solution, because it punishes people before giving them a good alternative.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a bigger difference than punishment.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (مو الحل)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة: درسنا المشكلة وغيّرنا الطريقة. اربطها: الحكومة تحسّن المواصلات أول.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, making driving more expensive is not the best solution, because it punishes people before giving them a good alternative. I think governments should study the problem first and change the way the system works. For example, at my work, the main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, governments should improve public transport first, and then people will drive less. This experience taught me that good planning can make a bigger difference than punishment.

transforms.q: Let's turn to driving now. When did you learn to drive, and what do you remember about it?
transforms.opener_en: I learned to drive many years ago, when I was about eighteen, and I still remember that the first weeks were not easy.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I can drive easily, and this experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: خذ هيكل 1 وبدّل الإنجليزي بالسواقة: صعب أول لأني أخاف من الأخطاء ← تدريب يومي (useful rules and simple routes) ← صرت واثق. زد جملة «أول مرة سقت لحالي» عشان «what do you remember». الخاتمة درس.
transforms.answer_en: I learned to drive many years ago, when I was about eighteen, and I still remember that the first weeks were not easy. At first, driving was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes, especially in busy streets. I started practicing every day and learning useful rules and simple routes. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. I also remember the first time I drove alone without anyone next to me, which felt like a big achievement. Now, I can drive easily, and this experience taught me that regular practice can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Thinking about society, what are the main causes of accidents on the roads where you live?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, the main causes of accidents where I live are high speed, using mobile phones while driving, and drivers who are in a hurry.
transforms.closer_en: This is why I believe that patience and responsibility on the road can prevent many accidents.
transforms.change_ar: الأسباب برأيك أول (سرعة، جوال، عجلة)، ثم اربطها بالصبر: For example قلب قصة الوالد — هادي، وعلّمني المسؤولية، وأتذكر نصيحته بالزحمة. الخاتمة الصبر والمسؤولية بالطريق.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, the main causes of accidents where I live are high speed, using mobile phones while driving, and drivers who are in a hurry. Most of these problems happen because people are not patient on the road. For example, my father is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard, and I still remember his advice in heavy traffic. He taught me that patience can help people succeed, and I think this is true for drivers too. This is why I believe that patience and responsibility on the road can prevent many accidents.

transforms.q: Finally, do you think self-driving cars will make roads safer in the future?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, self-driving cars will probably make roads safer in the future, because most accidents happen because of human mistakes.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think technology will become even more important, and many tasks, like driving, will become automatic.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم جملتي الميزة والعيب من قصة 7 حرفيًا، واربط العيب بالسيارة. الخاتمة المستقبل نفسها.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, self-driving cars will probably make roads safer in the future, because most accidents happen because of human mistakes. At work, I have seen how technology has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, and in a car, a technical problem can be dangerous. So I think we still need good testing and clear rules before these cars are everywhere. In the future, I think technology will become even more important, and many tasks, like driving, will become automatic.

transforms.q: Let's start with studying. Where and when do you usually study best?
transforms.opener_en: I usually study best at home in the evening, when the house is quiet and I have finished my work.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب وين ومتى (البيت، المساء)، ثم قلب قصة Duolingo كمثال على طريقتك بالمذاكرة: كل يوم ومراجعة الأخطاء.
transforms.answer_en: I usually study best at home in the evening, when the house is quiet and I have finished my work. At the moment, I am preparing for the Duolingo English Test, and I started preparing because I need the score for my university studies. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day, usually for about an hour in the evening, and reviewing my mistakes. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.

transforms.q: Now more generally. Do you think students in your country study in an effective way?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, many students in my country study hard, but not always in an effective way, because they memorize a lot instead of practicing.
transforms.closer_en: So I think students can study more effectively if they practice a little every day instead of memorizing everything at the end.
transforms.change_ar: رأي عام أول (يذاكرون كثير بس مو بفعالية)، ثم نفسك مثال: قلب قصة الإنجليزي — تدريب يومي بدل الحفظ.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, many students in my country study hard, but not always in an effective way, because they memorize a lot instead of practicing. I learned this from my own experience with English. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident, and I improved much faster than when I only memorized lists of words. So I think students can study more effectively if they practice a little every day instead of memorizing everything at the end.

transforms.q: Here's a harder one. Some people say that studying in a group is a waste of time. What do you think?
transforms.opener_en: I do not agree. In my opinion, studying in a group can be very useful if the group is organized, because people can solve problems faster together.
transforms.closer_en: This experience showed me that teamwork can make a big difference, and I think the same is true for studying.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (ما أوافق)، ثم For example بقلب قصة النظام كمثال على الفريق. أضف However لو المجموعة مو جادة. الخاتمة فريق.
transforms.answer_en: I do not agree. In my opinion, studying in a group can be very useful if the group is organized, because people can solve problems faster together. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully because everyone worked together. However, if the group is not serious, it can become a waste of time, so it depends on the people. This experience showed me that teamwork can make a big difference, and I think the same is true for studying.

transforms.q: Let's move on to exams. How do you usually feel before an important test?
transforms.opener_en: To be honest, I usually feel a little nervous before an important test, but I also feel ready if I have practiced enough.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I am working hard to get a higher score, and I feel less stressed because I know what to expect.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب بالشعور أول (متوتر شوي بس جاهز)، ثم قلب قصة Duolingo: السبب والتدريب اليومي. لا تذكر الـ85 هنا، خلّها للسؤال الجاي.
transforms.answer_en: To be honest, I usually feel a little nervous before an important test, but I also feel ready if I have practiced enough. For example, I am preparing for the Duolingo English Test now, and I started preparing because I need the score for my university studies, so I feel some pressure. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes, and this makes me feel more confident before the test. Now, I am working hard to get a higher score, and I feel less stressed because I know what to expect.

transforms.q: Thinking more broadly, do exams really show a student's ability?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, exams show part of a student's ability, but not everything.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think exams are useful for feedback, but they are only one part of the picture.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (تبيّن جزء بس)، ثم For example الـ85: بيّنت نقاط ضعفي بس ما بيّنت اجتهادي. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, exams show part of a student's ability, but not everything. For example, my first score on the Duolingo English Test was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. The score showed my weak points in reading and writing, but it did not show how hard I can work or how much I improved later. I need the score for my university studies, so I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes, and my level went up. Overall, I think exams are useful for feedback, but they are only one part of the picture.

transforms.q: Finally, if you could change one thing about the way students are tested, what would it be?
transforms.opener_en: If I could change one thing, I would give students more practice tests and clear feedback on their mistakes.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and the same is true for testing.
transforms.change_ar: قول التغيير اللي تبيه أول، ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة: درسنا المشكلة وغيّرنا الطريقة. اربطها بالمدارس. الخاتمة درس التخطيط.
transforms.answer_en: If I could change one thing, I would give students more practice tests and clear feedback on their mistakes. In my opinion, a test should help students improve, not only judge them. For example, at my work, the main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked, and in the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, schools should study the problem and change the way they test students. This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and the same is true for testing.

transforms.q: Let's start with the news. How do you usually follow what is happening in the world?
transforms.opener_en: I usually follow the news on my phone, through news apps and social media, and sometimes I watch the news on TV with my family in the evening.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب مباشرة (الجوال)، ثم قبل/الحين وجملة السبب من قصة 7. الخاتمة رأي 7 الجاهزة.
transforms.answer_en: I usually follow the news on my phone, through news apps and social media, and sometimes I watch the news on TV with my family in the evening. In the past, people depended more on TV and newspapers. Today, we can read the news instantly on our phones from anywhere. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and follow important events quickly. However, sometimes there is too much news, and not all of it is true, so I try to check the source. Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way.

transforms.q: More generally, do people in your country trust the news they read?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, people in my country trust some news sources, but they do not trust everything they read online.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think people should check the source before they believe a story.
transforms.change_ar: ما فيه قصة مباشرة. رأي أول، ثم هيكل 7: ميزة ثم However ثم Overall. لا تدخل النظام ولا الشغل.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, people in my country trust some news sources, but they do not trust everything they read online. There are both advantages and disadvantages to online news. It has helped us save time and follow events quickly, and most people still trust the official channels. However, sometimes people share stories that are not true, and this can cause confusion for a short time. Because of this, many people, including my family, now compare two or three sources before they believe something. Overall, I think people should check the source before they believe a story.

transforms.q: Here's a bigger question. Should news be free, or should people pay for good journalism?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, basic news should be free, but people should be ready to pay for high-quality journalism.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a mix of both is the best solution.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الأساسي مجاني، الجودة بفلوس)، ثم هيكل مميزات/عيوب من 7، وOverall. القصة ما تدخل هنا.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, basic news should be free, but people should be ready to pay for high-quality journalism. There are both advantages and disadvantages. Free news helps everyone stay informed, and it has helped us save time and follow events quickly. However, sometimes free news is not checked well, and this can cause problems when people share wrong information. Good journalism needs time and money, so if nobody pays, the quality goes down. Overall, I think a mix of both is the best solution.

transforms.q: Let's change topics and talk about influencers. Do you follow anyone on social media regularly?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I follow a few accounts regularly, mostly ones that help me improve my English, because I need it for my studies and work.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I can speak more easily, and I hope to improve even more in the future.
transforms.change_ar: قول نعم وحدد: حسابات تعليم إنجليزي، ثم قلب قصة الإنجليزي نفسها. الخاتمة مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I follow a few accounts regularly, mostly ones that help me improve my English, because I need it for my studies and work. At first, speaking was difficult for me because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures, and these accounts give me short videos with new words every day. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. I do not follow many famous influencers, because I prefer content that teaches me something. Now, I can speak more easily, and I hope to improve even more in the future.

transforms.q: Thinking about society, how do influencers affect the way young people spend money?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, influencers have a big effect on the way young people spend money, because young people see a product many times and want to buy it quickly.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think social media is useful when people use it in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم قالب 7 بموضوع الشراء: قبل/الحين، السبب نفسه، ميزة، However. الخاتمة رأي 7.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, influencers have a big effect on the way young people spend money, because young people see a product many times and want to buy it quickly. In the past, people bought mainly what they needed, and advertising was mostly on TV. Today, young people see new products on their phones every day. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and find good products easily. However, sometimes young people buy things they do not need, only because someone they follow has them. Overall, I think social media is useful when people use it in a smart way.

transforms.q: Finally, should influencers be responsible for the products they promote?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think influencers should be responsible for the products they promote, because many people trust them.
transforms.closer_en: For this reason, I think influencers should only promote products they really trust.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (نعم)، ثم اربطها بالمسؤولية: جملة الوالد «علّمني أتحمل المسؤولية» و«أحترم رأيه لأنه يفكر بالناس أول»، واربط المؤثرين بالمتابعين. اختم For this reason. لا تسرد قصة الوالد كاملة.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think influencers should be responsible for the products they promote, because many people trust them. In my opinion, when someone has a big audience, they also have a big responsibility. When I was younger, my father taught me to take responsibility and work hard, and I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, because he always thinks about other people first. Influencers should think about their followers in the same way, because a bad product can harm a lot of people. For this reason, I think influencers should only promote products they really trust.

transforms.q: Some universities have made attendance at lectures optional because all lectures are recorded. Do you agree with this change? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I agree with this change, because recorded lectures give students more flexibility.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think recorded lectures are useful when students use them in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: قل «Yes, I agree» وليش أول، ثم قصة 7 بنسخة التعليم (قبل كتب وفصل / الحين تسجيلات)، وخل السبب والميزة والعيب زي ما هي، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I agree with this change, because recorded lectures give students more flexibility. In the past, students depended more on books and classroom lessons. Today, students can watch recorded lectures and use digital tools at any time. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. For example, it has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, so a live class is still useful for questions and discussion. Overall, I think recorded lectures are useful when students use them in a smart way.

transforms.q: You supported the recordings. Do you think optional attendance changes the atmosphere of a course, or the relationship between students and professors?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think optional attendance can change the atmosphere a little, because fewer students come to the classroom.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think recorded lectures are useful when students still meet their professors face to face.
transforms.change_ar: سؤال متابعة: قل Yes وليش، ثم قلب قصة 7 بس، وبدّل العيب لـ«less time face to face» واربطه بالعلاقة مع الدكاترة. لا تعيد القصة من أولها.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think optional attendance can change the atmosphere a little, because fewer students come to the classroom. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, people may spend less time talking face to face, so the relationship between students and professors can become weaker. For example, when students only watch recordings, they do not ask questions or discuss ideas in class. In my opinion, universities should keep some live classes or office hours. Overall, I think recorded lectures are useful when students still meet their professors face to face.

transforms.q: Some employers look at candidates' social media accounts before deciding whether to hire them. Do you think this is acceptable? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, this is acceptable if employers only look at public and professional accounts, because social media can show whether a person is responsible.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think checking social media is useful when employers use it in a smart and fair way.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (وقل «public and professional accounts» عشان سؤال المتابعة)، ثم قصة 7 بزاوية التوظيف: قبل السيرة الذاتية بس، الحين يشوفون الحسابات. غيّر «us» لـ«employers» وغيّر العيب للبوستات الشخصية.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, this is acceptable if employers only look at public and professional accounts, because social media can show whether a person is responsible. In the past, employers depended only on the CV and the interview. Today, they can also check a candidate's online profile in a few minutes. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped employers save time and organize their work better. However, people may post personal things just for fun, and this does not show their real work skills. Overall, I think checking social media is useful when employers use it in a smart and fair way.

transforms.q: You mentioned professional accounts. Should candidates be told that their social media was checked, and should they get a chance to explain something the employer found?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think candidates should be told, because this is fair and honest.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think being honest with candidates shows that a company respects people.
transforms.change_ar: مجبور شوي: قل Yes مباشرة، ثم جملتين من قصة أبوك (صفاته + نحترم الرأي لو ما اتفقنا) كمثال للعدل والاحترام، والباقي رأيك عن فرصة التوضيح.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think candidates should be told, because this is fair and honest. My father taught me this kind of respect. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and he always listens to my side before he decides. In the same way, if an employer finds something on social media, they should give the candidate a chance to explain. For example, a post can be old or just a joke, and the person may have changed. This helps both sides make a fair decision. Overall, I think being honest with candidates shows that a company respects people.

transforms.q: Talk about a job you would like to try for one day. — What is the job, and why does it interest you? | What do you think a normal day in that job is like? | What would be the hardest part for you?
transforms.opener_en: One job I would like to try for one day is being a hospital manager, because I like solving problems with a team.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think this job would teach me a lot about leadership.

transforms.answer_en: One job I would like to try for one day is being a hospital manager, because I like solving problems with a team. A normal day in that job is full of unexpected situations. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. The hardest part for me would be the pressure, because a manager has to make quick decisions. Overall, I think this job would teach me a lot about leadership.

transforms.q: Talk about a healthy meal you know how to cook. — What is the meal and what is in it? | How do you make it? | When and why do you usually cook it?

transforms.answer_en: One healthy meal I know how to cook is grilled chicken with rice and salad. To make it, I grill the chicken, cook the rice, and cut the vegetables. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together.

This experience taught me the importance of being prepared and staying calm.

These simple activities are special to me because they help me stay healthy and spend quality time with my family.
