transforms.answer_en: To be honest, I have not bought many second-hand items, but I think it has become much easier to do this today. In the past, people had to go to a special market to find used items. Today, people can buy and sell used items through apps on their phones. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and find what we need more easily. However, sometimes a used item can have technical problems, so there is a risk. In the future, I think buying second-hand items will become even more common, and I may try it more often.

transforms.q: Thinking about society, why do some people avoid buying used items?
transforms.opener_en: I think some people avoid used items because they are afraid the item will break and cause problems.
transforms.closer_en: This is why many people prefer new items with a guarantee, even if they cost more.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (يخافون الغرض يخرب)، ثم For example بقصة النظام كمثال على الضغط لما شي يتعطل. الخاتمة رأي (يفضلون الجديد بضمان).
transforms.answer_en: I think some people avoid used items because they are afraid the item will break and cause problems. People know that when something stops working, it can be very stressful. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. With a used item, the risk of a problem like this is higher. This is why many people prefer new items with a guarantee, even if they cost more.

transforms.q: Finally, do you think companies should be required to make products easier to repair?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think companies should be required to make products easier to repair, because it saves money and reduces waste.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and such a rule would push companies to plan better.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (نعم، يوفر فلوس ويقلل الهدر)، ثم قلب قصة الخدمة كمثال إن دراسة المشكلة تغيّر النتيجة. اربطها بتصميم المنتجات بجملة وحدة.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think companies should be required to make products easier to repair, because it saves money and reduces waste. For example, one of my important goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, companies can study the problem and change the way they design products. This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and such a rule would push companies to plan better.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you had to solve a problem at work or school quickly. What was the problem, what did you do, and what did you learn from the experience?
transforms.opener_en: One time I had to solve a problem quickly was when our computer system suddenly went down at work.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared.
transforms.change_ar: غيّر أول جملة بس «One time I had to solve a problem quickly…» وزد «so I had to act fast»، والباقي نفس القصة والدرس بالآخر.
transforms.answer_en: One time I had to solve a problem quickly was when our computer system suddenly went down at work. It was a serious problem because we use the system for most of our work, so I had to act fast. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared.

transforms.q: Tell me about a well-known tourist site.
transforms.opener_en: One well-known tourist site is Madinah, the city where I live with my family. Many visitors come every year to see its famous mosque and historical places.
transforms.closer_en: I think visitors can have a memorable experience there.
transforms.change_ar: نفس قصة المدينة: بدّل أول جملة إنها موقع سياحي مشهور يزوره ناس كثير، وزد «people can enjoy a calm atmosphere»، وخاتمة السياح بدل المستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: One well-known tourist site is Madinah, the city where I live with my family. Many visitors come every year to see its famous mosque and historical places. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, and people can enjoy a calm atmosphere. I enjoy spending time with my family there, especially on weekends. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. I think visitors can have a memorable experience there.

transforms.q: How can places with tourist sites balance the needs of tourists with those of residents?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, cities with tourist sites can balance both needs with good planning, so services are enough for everyone.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive for both tourists and residents.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (تخطيط جيد)، ثم For example المدينة بقلب القصة وجملة «It has become more modern…»، والخاتمة مستقبل المدينة للسياح والسكان.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, cities with tourist sites can balance both needs with good planning, so services are enough for everyone. For example, many visitors come to Madinah, where I live with my family. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, and it has become more modern, with more services for everyone. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and tourists can enjoy the same places. I have lived here for many years, and good planning has helped both residents and visitors. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive for both tourists and residents.

transforms.q: Do you enjoy watching comedy? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I enjoy watching comedy because it helps me relax and forget the stress of work.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think comedy is a good way to relax after a busy day.
transforms.change_ar: القصة ما تخدم السؤال كثير: جاوب نعم وليش، وبعدين For example خذ جملة العائلة والويكند وجملة العشاء والحديقة بس وزد «watch a funny show»، ولا تتكلم عن المدينة كمكان، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I enjoy watching comedy because it helps me relax and forget the stress of work. For example, I enjoy spending time with my family on weekends, and we often watch a funny show together. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together at home. We have done this for many years, and it makes every weekend special. My work at the hospital can be stressful, so laughing with my family helps me feel better. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together. Overall, I think comedy is a good way to relax after a busy day.

transforms.q: Some people say British humor is different from American humor. What do you think?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, British and American humor are different because each culture has its own style, but both can be funny.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think this difference is interesting and helps people understand English better.
transforms.change_ar: سؤال بعيد عن قصصك: ابدأ برأيك، وبعدين اربطه بقطعة الإنجليزي (فهم النكت كان صعب ← تدريب يومي ← صرت أفهم)، وغيّر جملة السبب.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, British and American humor are different because each culture has its own style, but both can be funny. I noticed this when I started improving my English because I need it for my studies and work. At first, understanding jokes was difficult for me because I did not know many words. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures, and sometimes I watched British and American shows. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident, and now I can understand both kinds of humor more easily. Overall, I think this difference is interesting and helps people understand English better.

transforms.q: Is it important for people to laugh at work? Why?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I think it is important for people to laugh at work because it reduces stress and helps the team work together.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a little laughter at work helps people stay calm and solve problems together.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (الضحك يخفف الضغط)، ثم For example بقلب قصة النظام وزد «we tried to stay calm and positive» و«joked a little to feel better»، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I think it is important for people to laugh at work because it reduces stress and helps the team work together. For example, one day at work our computer system suddenly went down, and it was a serious problem because we use the system for most of our work. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan, and we tried to stay calm and positive. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully because everyone supported each other and even joked a little to feel better. Overall, I think a little laughter at work helps people stay calm and solve problems together.

transforms.q: Do you think online learning is as effective as learning in a classroom? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, online learning can be effective, but it is not always as effective as learning in a classroom.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think online learning is useful when people use it in a smart way, but the classroom is still important.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم نسخة التعليم من قطعة التقنية (قبل ← الحين ← السبب ← ميزة ← However)، وخاتمة «Overall» مع إن الفصل مهم.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, online learning can be effective, but it is not always as effective as learning in a classroom. In the past, students depended more on books and classroom lessons. Today, students can use online courses, videos, and digital tools. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped students save time and organize their studies better. They can also learn from almost anywhere. However, online learning can sometimes be distracting, and students get less support from the teacher. Overall, I think online learning is useful when people use it in a smart way, but the classroom is still important.

transforms.q: Some people think exams are the best way to measure what students have learned. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples.
transforms.opener_en: I partly agree, because exams show students what they need to improve, but they do not measure everything.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think exams are a good tool when they are used together with daily practice.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أوافق جزئيًا)، ثم For example قلب قصة دولينقو والـ85 بس، والخاتمة رأي مو «working hard».
transforms.answer_en: I partly agree, because exams show students what they need to improve, but they do not measure everything. For example, I am preparing for the Duolingo English Test because I need the score for my university studies. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience, and it showed me which skills I needed to improve. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes, and I improved more than one exam could show. Overall, I think exams are a good tool when they are used together with daily practice.

transforms.q: Describe a time when a teacher helped you learn something difficult. What did they do, and how did it change you?
transforms.opener_en: The teacher who helped me most in my life was actually my father, not a teacher at school.
transforms.closer_en: He taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed, and this changed the way I face problems.
transforms.change_ar: السؤال يقول teacher — خلّ أبوك هو «المعلم» بأول جملة وما تغيّر شي بالقصة، وزد جملة وش سوى (شرح بصبر) وجملة كيف غيّرك بالخاتمة.
transforms.answer_en: The teacher who helped me most in my life was actually my father, not a teacher at school. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard, which was difficult for me at that time. He explained things patiently, gave me useful advice, and showed me by his own example. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion. He taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed, and this changed the way I face problems.

transforms.q: Should schools give students less homework and more time for creative activities? Why?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, schools should give some homework, but also more time for creative activities, because students learn better when they enjoy learning.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a balance between homework and creative activities is the best way to learn.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (توازن)، ثم For example قطعة الإنجليزي كدليل: التدريب اليومي مهم بس التعلم الممتع ساعدني أكثر، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, schools should give some homework, but also more time for creative activities, because students learn better when they enjoy learning. For example, when I started improving my English, speaking was difficult for me at first because I was afraid of making mistakes. I started practicing every day and learning useful words and simple sentence structures, but I also learned a lot from fun activities like watching videos and talking with people. Although it was difficult at first, I became more confident. Overall, I think a balance between homework and creative activities is the best way to learn.

transforms.q: Would you like to study in another country? What would be the advantages and disadvantages for you?
transforms.opener_en: Yes, I would like to study in another country because it would help me improve my English.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I am working hard to get a higher score to be ready for this opportunity.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب نعم وليش، وقسّم: ميزة وعيب بجملتين، ثم قلب قصة دولينقو (السبب، الصعوبة، التدريب، الـ85)، والخاتمة «working hard» مربوطة بالفرصة.
transforms.answer_en: Yes, I would like to study in another country because it would help me improve my English. One advantage is that I would practice English every day. On the other hand, one disadvantage is that I would be far from my family in Madinah. In fact, I started preparing for the Duolingo English Test because I need the score for my university studies. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. Now, I am working hard to get a higher score to be ready for this opportunity.

transforms.q: Do you think working from home is better than working in an office? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, it depends on the job, but for me the office is better because I work with a team.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think working from home is useful for some jobs, but teamwork in the office is still very important.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (يعتمد على الوظيفة، بس أنا أفضّل المكتب عشان الفريق)، ثم For example قلب قصة النظام وزد «because we were all in the same place»، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, it depends on the job, but for me the office is better because I work with a team. Working from home can save time, but it is difficult to solve problems together. For example, one day at work our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully because we were all in the same place. Overall, I think working from home is useful for some jobs, but teamwork in the office is still very important.

transforms.q: Some people think a high salary is the most important thing in a job. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons.
transforms.opener_en: I disagree, because a high salary is important, but doing useful work and being part of a good team matter more.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a good salary matters, but job satisfaction is more important.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (ما أوافق)، ثم For example قلب قصة تحسين الخدمة وزد «I felt proud of this result, not because of money»، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I disagree, because a high salary is important, but doing useful work and being part of a good team matter more. For example, one of my important goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot, and I felt proud of this result, not because of money. Overall, I think a good salary matters, but job satisfaction is more important.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you had to work as part of a team. What happened, and what did you learn?
transforms.opener_en: One good example of teamwork happened when our computer system went down at work.
transforms.closer_en: This experience showed me how important teamwork is during difficult situations.
transforms.change_ar: غيّر أول جملة لمدخل الفريق، وركّز على «everyone worked together»، والباقي نفس القصة وخاتمة الفريق.
transforms.answer_en: One good example of teamwork happened when our computer system went down at work. It was a serious problem because we use the system for most of our work. First, I informed my team and explained the backup plan. Then, everyone worked together to continue the service manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. This experience showed me how important teamwork is during difficult situations.

transforms.q: Would you prefer to work for a small company or a large company? Explain your choice.
transforms.opener_en: I would prefer to work for a large company because it has more resources, more people to learn from, and a better backup plan when problems happen.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a large organization gives people more support and more chances to grow.
transforms.change_ar: اختر «large» وقول ليش بأول جملة، ثم For example المستشفى الكبير وقلب قصة النظام (الفريق الكبير والخطة البديلة)، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I would prefer to work for a large company because it has more resources, more people to learn from, and a better backup plan when problems happen. For example, I work in a large hospital, and one day our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully because we had a big team and a clear plan. Overall, I think a large organization gives people more support and more chances to grow.

transforms.q: What makes a good manager? Give reasons and examples.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, a good manager is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others, because the team needs someone they can trust.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a good manager stays calm, works hard, and helps the team succeed.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول بصفات أبوك نفسها وسبب قصير، ثم For example أبوك كمثال بقلب القصة، وزد إن المدير الزين يسمع الآراء، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, a good manager is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others, because the team needs someone they can trust. For example, my father has these qualities, and he influenced me a lot. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations at work. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and a good manager also listens to different opinions. He taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed. Overall, I think a good manager stays calm, works hard, and helps the team succeed.

transforms.q: Do you think children should have smartphones before the age of 12? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, children should not have smartphones before the age of 12, because they are too young to use them in a smart way.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, and children can learn this when they are older.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم قالب المميزات والعيوب من قطعة التقنية (ميزة ← However عن الأطفال)، والخاتمة «Overall… smart way».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, children should not have smartphones before the age of 12, because they are too young to use them in a smart way. Technology has many advantages and disadvantages. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. Children can also use it to learn new things. However, children under 12 can spend too much time on games and social media, which affects their studies and health. Parents can give them a phone later and teach them to use it well. Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, and children can learn this when they are older.

transforms.q: Some people think social media does more harm than good. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples.
transforms.opener_en: I partly disagree, because social media has both advantages and disadvantages, and the result depends on how people use it.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think social media is useful when people use it in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (ما أوافق جزئيًا)، ثم نسخة التواصل من قطعة التقنية (قبل ← الحين ← ميزة + For example ← However)، والخاتمة «Overall… smart way».
transforms.answer_en: I partly disagree, because social media has both advantages and disadvantages, and the result depends on how people use it. In the past, communication was slower, and people depended more on phone calls and face-to-face meetings. Today, people can send messages or make video calls instantly. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. For example, we can share information with our team quickly. However, people can spend too much time on it, and sometimes false information spreads quickly. So the harm comes from how people use it. Overall, I think social media is useful when people use it in a smart way.

transforms.q: Describe a time when technology helped you solve a problem at work or at home.
transforms.opener_en: One time technology helped me solve a problem at work was when my team and I wanted to improve a service for patients.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning and technology can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: قصة النظام ما تنفع هنا لأنها عن تعطل التقنية — خذ قصة تحسين الخدمة وزد إن نظام الكمبيوتر ساعدكم تنظمون المواعيد، والباقي نفس القصة.
transforms.answer_en: One time technology helped me solve a problem at work was when my team and I wanted to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked, using our computer system to organize appointments and follow the waiting time. At first, it was difficult, but everyone worked together. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. This experience taught me that good planning and technology can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Will robots and artificial intelligence take away more jobs than they create? Explain your opinion.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, robots and AI will change many jobs, but they will not take away more jobs than they create.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think technology will become even more important and many tasks will become automatic, but new jobs will appear too.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول، ثم قطعة التقنية بالحاضر والسبب والميزة والعيب وزد «people are still needed»، والخاتمة مستقبل مع «new jobs will appear».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, robots and AI will change many jobs, but they will not take away more jobs than they create. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, but people are still needed to make decisions. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work for a short time, so we still need people who understand the work. In the future, I think technology will become even more important and many tasks will become automatic, but new jobs will appear too.

transforms.q: Is online shopping better than shopping in stores? Give two reasons for your answer.
transforms.opener_en: I think online shopping is better for two reasons: it saves time, and it is easier to compare prices.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think online shopping is useful when people use it in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: جاوب بالسببين بأول جملة، ثم قالب التقنية (قبل ← الحين ← السبب ← ميزة ← However) بموضوع التسوق، والخاتمة «Overall… smart way».
transforms.answer_en: I think online shopping is better for two reasons: it saves time, and it is easier to compare prices. In the past, people had to visit many stores, and shopping took a long time. Today, we can order almost everything online. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our shopping better. We can also compare prices easily. However, sometimes technical problems can happen, and you cannot see the product before you buy it. Overall, I think online shopping is useful when people use it in a smart way.

transforms.q: Do you think people today are healthier than people were fifty years ago? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, people today are healthier in some ways because medicine has improved, but they have new problems too.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think people are healthier today, but they need to use technology in a smart way and stay active.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (أصح بجوانب وفيه مشاكل جديدة)، ثم قالب التقنية (قبل ← الحين ← السبب ← ميزة ← However) بموضوع الصحة والمستشفى، والخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, people today are healthier in some ways because medicine has improved, but they have new problems too. In the past, many tasks took a long time, and people did more physical work. Today, hospitals use digital systems, and doctors can treat many diseases better. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, so patients get faster treatment. However, people today move less and spend a long time in front of screens. Overall, I think people are healthier today, but they need to use technology in a smart way and stay active.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you changed a habit to improve your health. What did you do, and how did you feel?
transforms.opener_en: One habit I changed to improve my health was sitting for many hours without any exercise. Recently, I started walking because I need it for my health.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I feel healthier, and I want to continue this habit in the future.
transforms.change_ar: هيكل قطعة الإنجليزي نفسه بس بدّل الإنجليزي بالمشي: At first it was difficult ← I started walking every day ← Although it was difficult at first, I became more active. زد جملة «I felt much better» عشان جزء الشعور، والخاتمة خاتمة العادة.
transforms.answer_en: One habit I changed to improve my health was sitting for many hours without any exercise. Recently, I started walking because I need it for my health. At first, walking was difficult for me because I was not used to it. I started walking every day and doing simple exercises at home, and on weekends I walk in a park in Madinah with my family. Although it was difficult at first, I became more active, and I felt much better. Now, I feel healthier, and I want to continue this habit in the future.

transforms.q: What is the biggest cause of stress for people in your country, and how do they deal with it?
transforms.opener_en: I think the biggest cause of stress for people in my country is work pressure, especially when something unexpected happens.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think teamwork and being prepared are the best ways to deal with stress.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (ضغط الشغل) ثم For example بقلب قصة النظام بس. لا تنسَ الجزء الثاني «كيف يتعاملون»: جملة وحدة — يهدون ويشتغلون كفريق ويرتاحون مع العائلة.
transforms.answer_en: I think the biggest cause of stress for people in my country is work pressure, especially when something unexpected happens. For example, one day at work, our computer system suddenly went down. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. I think most people deal with stress in the same way: they stay calm, work as a team, and relax with their families on weekends. Overall, I think teamwork and being prepared are the best ways to deal with stress.

transforms.q: Do you think it's better to see a doctor online or in person? Explain your choice.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, seeing a doctor in person is usually better, but online appointments are useful for simple cases.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, but serious cases still need a face-to-face visit.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (وجهًا لوجه أفضل غالبًا)، ثم For example بقلب قطعة التقنية: الحاضر والسبب والميزة والعيب. احذف جملة الماضي، وزد بالعيب «الدكتور ما يقدر يفحص من الشاشة».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, seeing a doctor in person is usually better, but online appointments are useful for simple cases. For example, I work in a hospital, and today we use computers and digital systems for most of our work. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better, and online appointments can reduce waiting time for patients. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work, and a doctor cannot examine a patient through a screen. Overall, I think technology is useful when people use it in a smart way, but serious cases still need a face-to-face visit.

transforms.q: Do you think recycling should be required by law? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, recycling should be required by law, because most people only change their habits when there is a clear rule.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think recycling will become more important, and a clear law can make this change faster.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (لازم قانون)، ثم For example بمثال الورق ← الأنظمة الرقمية من قطعة التقنية، وزد «because everyone had to follow the new system» عشان يخدم فكرة القانون. احذف جملة المشاكل التقنية — القطعة مو طبيعية هنا فخلّها قصيرة.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, recycling should be required by law, because most people only change their habits when there is a clear rule. For example, ten years ago, we used more paper at work. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work, so we waste less paper. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use, and because everyone had to follow the new system. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, some people need time to accept a new rule. In the future, I think recycling will become more important, and a clear law can make this change faster.

transforms.q: Some people say the government should fix environmental problems, not ordinary people. Do you agree? Explain why.
transforms.opener_en: I do not fully agree with this idea. In my opinion, the government should lead, but ordinary people also have to help, because big problems are solved by teamwork.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think the environment is a shared responsibility, and teamwork can make a big difference.
transforms.change_ar: ما توافق كليًا: الحكومة تقود والناس يساعدون = فريق. ثم For example بقلب قصة النظام (3 جمل) وجملة تربطها بالبيئة.
transforms.answer_en: I do not fully agree with this idea. In my opinion, the government should lead, but ordinary people also have to help, because big problems are solved by teamwork. For example, when our computer system went down at work, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, we continued our work manually until the system came back. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully because everyone did their part. In the same way, the government can make the rules, but people must change their habits. Overall, I think the environment is a shared responsibility, and teamwork can make a big difference.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you did something to help the environment. What did you do, and how did you feel?
transforms.opener_en: One thing I did to help the environment was reducing the paper I use at work.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think technology will help us protect the environment even more.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة التقنية كاملة بس المدخل «قللت الورق بالشغل»، وزد جملة الشعور «I felt good…». القطعة مو مثالية هنا لكنها الأقرب.
transforms.answer_en: One thing I did to help the environment was reducing the paper I use at work. Ten years ago, we used more paper at work. Today, we use computers and digital systems for most of our work, and I do most of my tasks on the computer instead of printing. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and organize our work better. However, sometimes technical problems can stop the work. I felt good about this change because we waste much less paper now. In the future, I think technology will help us protect the environment even more.

transforms.q: What is the biggest environmental problem in your city, and how could it be solved?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, the biggest environmental problem in Madinah is traffic, because the city is growing and there are more cars every year.
transforms.closer_en: I think good planning and teamwork can make a big difference for the city too.
transforms.change_ar: المشكلة جملة رأي وحدة (الزحمة)، والحل من قلب قصة الخدمة: درسنا المشكلة وغيّرنا طريقة العمل. لا تسرد قصة المستشفى كاملة.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, the biggest environmental problem in Madinah is traffic, because the city is growing and there are more cars every year. I think this problem can be solved with good planning, similar to a problem we solved at work. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. In the same way, the city should study the traffic problem and improve public transport. I think good planning and teamwork can make a big difference for the city too.

transforms.q: Would you prefer to live in a big city with more jobs or a small town with cleaner air? Explain your choice.
transforms.opener_en: I would prefer to live in a big city with more jobs, and that is actually what I do now.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, so I am happy with my choice.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ بالاختيار (المدينة الكبيرة = المدينة المنورة)، ثم قلب قطعة المدينة، وجملة وحدة عن الشغل وجملة عن عيب الهواء.
transforms.answer_en: I would prefer to live in a big city with more jobs, and that is actually what I do now. I live in Madinah with my family, and I work at a hospital there. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. A small town may have cleaner air, but good services and jobs are more important for me. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, so I am happy with my choice.

transforms.q: Do you think cities should ban cars from their city centers? Why or why not?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, cities should not ban cars completely, but they should reduce cars in the center.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive if the center has fewer cars.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (تقليل مو منع)، ثم For example بقلب قطعة المدينة، وجملة However للعيب. ما تحتاج تقول إنها مكانك المفضل.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, cities should not ban cars completely, but they should reduce cars in the center. For example, I live in Madinah. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together in the center, and it is much nicer when there are fewer cars. I have lived here for many years, and I have seen how traffic has increased. However, elderly people and families with children still need to drive close to the center. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive if the center has fewer cars.

transforms.q: Some people think living in a big city is better than living in a small town. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons.
transforms.opener_en: I agree that living in a big city is usually better, because it has more services, more jobs, and more places to enjoy.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a big city gives people more opportunities, and that is why I prefer it.
transforms.change_ar: أوافق + السبب أول، ثم For example بقلب قطعة المدينة، وجملة عيب وحدة. الخاتمة رأي مو مستقبل.
transforms.answer_en: I agree that living in a big city is usually better, because it has more services, more jobs, and more places to enjoy. For example, I live in Madinah with my family. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, which a small town cannot offer. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. Of course, a big city can be noisy, but the advantages are bigger. Overall, I think a big city gives people more opportunities, and that is why I prefer it.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you were stuck in traffic. What happened and how did you feel?
transforms.opener_en: One time I was stuck in traffic was on my way to work, when the road to the hospital suddenly became very crowded.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared.
transforms.change_ar: هيكل قصة النظام بس المشكلة صارت زحمة بدل تعطل النظام: First أبلغت الفريق ← Then كملوا الشغل لين وصلت ← stressful لكن نجحنا. زد جملة الشعور «I felt nervous…».
transforms.answer_en: One time I was stuck in traffic was on my way to work, when the road to the hospital suddenly became very crowded. It was a serious problem because I had an important task at the hospital that morning. First, I informed my team and asked them to use the backup plan. Then, my team continued our work until I arrived. Although the situation was stressful, we managed it successfully. I felt nervous in the car, but afterwards I was happy that my team handled everything well. This experience taught me the importance of teamwork and being prepared.

transforms.q: What is the best way to improve public transport in your city? Explain your answer.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, the best way to improve public transport in Madinah is good planning: the city should study the problem first and then change the way the service works.
transforms.closer_en: I think good planning and teamwork can make a big difference for public transport too.
transforms.change_ar: رأي: التخطيط ودراسة المشكلة. ثم For example بقلب قصة الخدمة (انتظار ← درسنا ← قلّلنا)، وجملة تربطها بالباصات.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, the best way to improve public transport in Madinah is good planning: the city should study the problem first and then change the way the service works. For example, at work, the main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. Public transport is similar: if buses are on time and people do not wait for a long time, more people will use them. I think good planning and teamwork can make a big difference for public transport too.

transforms.q: Should governments spend more money on parks and green spaces or on new roads? Why?
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, governments should spend more money on parks and green spaces, because they improve people's daily life and health.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more attractive if it has more green spaces.
transforms.change_ar: رأي (الحدائق) ثم For example بمثال المدينة وعائلتك «visit a park…». جملة وحدة عن الطرق عشان الجزء الثاني من السؤال.
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, governments should spend more money on parks and green spaces, because they improve people's daily life and health. For example, I live in Madinah with my family. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and these simple activities help us spend quality time together. I have lived here for many years, and the parks are some of my favorite places. Of course, roads are also important, but many cities already have enough roads. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more attractive if it has more green spaces.

transforms.q: Do you prefer to plan your trips carefully or to be spontaneous? Why?
transforms.opener_en: I prefer to plan my trips carefully, because good planning saves time and helps me avoid problems.
transforms.closer_en: This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and that is why I plan my trips carefully.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ بالتفضيل (التخطيط)، ثم قلب قصة الخدمة كدليل إن التخطيط يفرق (المشكلة ← درسنا ← قلّلنا)، وجملة وحدة تربطها بالسفر. الخاتمة درس القطعة.
transforms.answer_en: I prefer to plan my trips carefully, because good planning saves time and helps me avoid problems. I learned this at work. One of my important goals at work was to improve a service for patients. The main problem was that patients had to wait for a long time. My team and I studied the problem and changed the way we worked. In the end, we reduced the waiting time a lot. When I travel, I like to book everything early and plan each day. This experience taught me that good planning can make a big difference, and that is why I plan my trips carefully.

transforms.q: Some people think guided tours are the best way to see a new country. Others prefer to explore on their own. Which do you prefer and why?
transforms.opener_en: I prefer to explore a new place on my own, because I like to take my time and relax without a fixed schedule.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think exploring on your own gives you a more personal and memorable experience.
transforms.change_ar: ابدأ بالتفضيل (لحالك)، ثم For example بقلب قطعة المدينة كمثال، وجملة إنصاف للجولات. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I prefer to explore a new place on my own, because I like to take my time and relax without a fixed schedule. For example, I live in Madinah. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, and we do not need a guide for that. I have lived here for many years, and I think visitors enjoy the city more when they discover it at their own pace. Of course, a guided tour can be useful for history. Overall, I think exploring on your own gives you a more personal and memorable experience.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you visited a place that was very crowded. What happened and how did you feel?
transforms.opener_en: One time I visited a very crowded place was a holiday evening in Madinah, when my family and I went out for dinner.
transforms.closer_en: These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together.
transforms.change_ar: قطعة المدينة بزاوية «ليلة زحمة»: المدخل عشاء بالإجازة، الجسم نفسه، وزد جملة الشعور «At first I felt stressed… in the end we enjoyed». مو قصة طبيعية فخلّها بسيطة.
transforms.answer_en: One time I visited a very crowded place was a holiday evening in Madinah, when my family and I went out for dinner. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, but on holidays many visitors come. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together, but that night every restaurant was full. At first, I felt a little stressed, but we stayed calm and enjoyed the evening in the end. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together.

transforms.q: Some people believe tourism does more harm than good to popular cities. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples.
transforms.opener_en: I disagree. In my opinion, tourism does more good than harm, because it brings jobs and services to a city.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and tourism will be one reason for that.
transforms.change_ar: ما توافق + السبب أول، ثم For example بقلب قطعة المدينة والتغيّر (more modern, more services)، وجملة However للزحمة.
transforms.answer_en: I disagree. In my opinion, tourism does more good than harm, because it brings jobs and services to a city. For example, I live in Madinah, which receives many visitors every year. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. I have lived here for many years, and I have seen the city become more modern, with more services, partly because of visitors. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. However, in busy seasons the city can be crowded. In the future, I think Madinah will become even more modern and attractive, and tourism will be one reason for that.

transforms.q: What advice would you give a friend who is visiting your city for the first time?
transforms.opener_en: If a friend visited Madinah for the first time, I would advise him to take his time and enjoy the calm atmosphere of the city.
transforms.closer_en: I think visitors can have a memorable experience there.
transforms.change_ar: نفس تحويل «مدينة تنصح السياح بزيارتها» بس المدخل «I would advise him to…»، وبعد جملة الأنشطة زد «I would tell him to do the same». الخاتمة خاتمة السياح.
transforms.answer_en: If a friend visited Madinah for the first time, I would advise him to take his time and enjoy the calm atmosphere of the city. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places, so there is no need to hurry. I live here with my family, and sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. I would tell him to do the same. I have lived here for many years, which makes the city very special to me, so I can show him the best places. I think visitors can have a memorable experience there.

transforms.q: Do you think it's better to have a few close friends or many friends? Why?
transforms.opener_en: I think it is better to have a few close friends, because real friendship needs trust and time.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think a few people you can really trust are worth more than many people you hardly know.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (قليل مقرّبين)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الوالد كمثال على الصفات اللي تبيها بالصديق. الخاتمة رأي.
transforms.answer_en: I think it is better to have a few close friends, because real friendship needs trust and time. For example, the person I am closest to is my father. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard. I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and I think a close friend should be like this: honest and always ready to help. Overall, I think a few people you can really trust are worth more than many people you hardly know.

transforms.q: Some people think elderly parents should live with their children instead of in a care home. Do you agree or disagree? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
transforms.opener_en: I agree, because family support is very important, and living together is normal in my culture.
transforms.closer_en: He taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed, and caring for our parents is part of that responsibility.
transforms.change_ar: أوافق + السبب أول، ثم For example بقلب قصة الوالد كمثال، وجملة «أبغى أعتني فيه مثل ما اعتنى فيني». لا تغيّر حقائق القصة.
transforms.answer_en: I agree, because family support is very important, and living together is normal in my culture. For example, my father is one of the most important people in my life. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and one day I want to take care of him in the same way he took care of me. He taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed, and caring for our parents is part of that responsibility.

transforms.q: Describe a time when a friend or a family member helped you. What happened, and how did you feel afterwards?
transforms.opener_en: One time a family member helped me was when my father supported me during a difficult time in my life.
transforms.closer_en: His support helped me deal with the situation better, and it taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed.
transforms.change_ar: نفس تحويل «شخص ساعدك بوقت صعب»: المدخل ساعدني، وسط القطعة «He stayed calm and gave me useful advice»، وزد جملة الشعور «Afterwards, I felt calmer».
transforms.answer_en: One time a family member helped me was when my father supported me during a difficult time in my life. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I had a serious problem, he stayed calm and gave me useful advice. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard, and I still remember his advice when I face difficult situations. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion. Afterwards, I felt calmer and more confident. His support helped me deal with the situation better, and it taught me that patience and hard work can help people succeed.

transforms.q: How has technology changed the way families stay in touch? Is this change mostly positive or negative?
transforms.opener_en: Technology has changed the way families stay in touch. In the past, communication was slower, and people depended more on phone calls and face-to-face meetings.
transforms.closer_en: In the future, I think technology will become even more important, but families still need to meet in person.
transforms.change_ar: نفس تحويل «كيف تغير التواصل» بس عن العائلة: الميزة «stay in touch more easily» والعيب «less time face to face». زد جملة رأي «mostly positive» لأن السؤال جزئين.
transforms.answer_en: Technology has changed the way families stay in touch. In the past, communication was slower, and people depended more on phone calls and face-to-face meetings. Today, family members can send messages or make video calls instantly. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and stay in touch more easily. However, sometimes technical problems can stop a call, and people may spend less time talking face to face. In my opinion, this change is mostly positive, because families stay connected easily. In the future, I think technology will become even more important, but families still need to meet in person.

transforms.q: What makes someone a good friend? Talk about the qualities you look for and give an example.
transforms.opener_en: In my opinion, a good friend is someone who is calm, honest, and always willing to help others.
transforms.closer_en: For this reason, I look for people like him when I choose my friends.
transforms.change_ar: الصفات أول (رأي)، ثم For example بقلب قصة الوالد كمثال. الخاتمة «أدور على ناس مثله».
transforms.answer_en: In my opinion, a good friend is someone who is calm, honest, and always willing to help others. For example, the person who shows these qualities best is my father, who is like a close friend to me. He is calm, hardworking, and always willing to help others. When I was younger, he taught me to take responsibility and work hard. Although we do not always agree, I respect his opinion, and I think this is important in a friend: you can disagree and still respect each other. For this reason, I look for people like him when I choose my friends.

transforms.q: Do you think it's better to spend money on experiences or on things? Why?
transforms.opener_en: I think it is better to spend money on experiences, because memories with the people you love last longer than things.
transforms.closer_en: These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together, and that is worth more than any new thing.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (التجارب)، ثم For example بمثال العائلة من قطعة المدينة (عشاء، حديقة). جملة وحدة عن الأشياء عشان المقارنة.
transforms.answer_en: I think it is better to spend money on experiences, because memories with the people you love last longer than things. For example, I live in Madinah with my family. It is a peaceful city with many interesting places. Sometimes we go out for dinner, visit a park, or simply relax together. These activities do not cost a lot, but I have done this for many years, and I still remember many of those evenings. New things, on the other hand, become boring quickly. These simple activities are special to me because they help us spend quality time together, and that is worth more than any new thing.

transforms.q: Some people think advertising makes us buy things we don't need. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons.
transforms.opener_en: I agree that advertising often makes us buy things we do not need, especially online.
transforms.closer_en: Overall, I think advertising is only a problem when people do not use their money in a smart way.
transforms.change_ar: رأي أول (I agree)، وقبل/الحين بسرعة بجملتين، وبعدين جملتين من قلب 7 (السبب + It has helped us save time). لا تسرد القطعة كلها، والخاتمة Overall.
transforms.answer_en: I agree that advertising often makes us buy things we do not need, especially online. In the past, we saw advertisements mainly on TV and in the street. Today, we see them on our phones all day. This change happened because technology became faster and easier to use. It has helped us save time and find useful products, but many people now buy things they did not plan to buy. However, I think people can control this if they think before they buy. Overall, I think advertising is only a problem when people do not use their money in a smart way.

transforms.q: Describe a time when you saved money for something important. What was it, and how did you feel?
transforms.opener_en: One time I saved money for something important was when I was preparing for the Duolingo English Test.
transforms.closer_en: Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.
transforms.change_ar: نفس قطعة 6 بس المدخل «وفّرت فلوس للاختبار»، وزد جملة وش وفّرت (saved a little every month) وجملة الشعور (I felt proud). الباقي نفس القصة.
transforms.answer_en: One time I saved money for something important was when I was preparing for the Duolingo English Test. I started preparing because I need the score for my university studies. The test and the books are not cheap, so I saved a little every month from my salary. At first, I found reading and writing difficult. However, I started practicing every day and reviewing my mistakes. My first score was 85, but I learned a lot from the experience. I felt proud because I paid with my own money, and it made me take the test more seriously. Now, I am working hard to get a higher score.

transforms.q: Some people rent a home for many years instead of buying one. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
transforms.opener_en: There are both advantages and disadvantages of renting a home for many years.
